# Support and issue scope

This repository is an independent community project that packages UHF Server for Docker. I maintain the Docker setup in my spare time and am not affiliated with Swapplications, which develops the UHF app and UHF Server. UHF product support, including support for paid subscriptions, is handled by its developers.

## Open issues here for the Docker setup

- Image build or dependency installation problems
- Container startup problems caused by the image or Compose configuration
- Volume mounts, file permissions, port mappings, health checks, or environment variables in the documented Docker Compose setup
- Updates to the packaged UHF Server or dependency versions
- Improvements or corrections to this repository's Docker setup and documentation

For a bug report, include the exact image tag, host OS and CPU architecture, Docker and Compose versions, steps to reproduce, and relevant configuration and logs. Remove passwords, tokens, stream URLs, and other private information before posting.

## Contact UHF support for product issues

- Recording, scheduling, playback, or other UHF app and server behavior
- FFmpeg commands generated by UHF Server or missing error output in its logs
- Native Windows, macOS, or Linux installations
- UHF product feature requests, accounts, purchases, or subscriptions

Report these through [UHF's official support page](https://getuhf.com/support). The published support email is [support@uhfapp.com](mailto:support@uhfapp.com).

A product bug remains the UHF developers' responsibility when it occurs inside Docker. Restricted issue creation in the upstream repository does not make this repository an alternative product support channel. Reports outside this repository's scope may be closed with a referral to UHF support.

If you are unsure whether a problem comes from the Docker setup, describe the evidence connecting it to the image or Compose configuration. You do not need to diagnose the root cause before asking. If it turns out to be a UHF product issue, follow up with UHF support.
